series.note: The fast at the mod's defaults (Realistic pace, Multiply), with water and no food. The starvation state opens after 30 unfed hours (K.drain.STARVE_ONSET_H), at 34.45 h, when Starving shows. Its remaining fraction falls on a straight line over the body's BMI progress, from a BMI of 22.38 at the onset to 12, starvation's death point (S2234), so health falls in a straight line with the body's own wasting and reaches 50 on day 43.88; vanilla's starving character is dead by day 2.62 (S2d-v-model-health). A heavier body loses BMI more slowly, so its line runs longer. The deficiencies follow as each vitamin turns Clinical (scurvy on day 40.21, then beriberi on day 42.23, then pellagra on day 55.24), each fraction falling on a line to 0 at its own death time (beriberi's 840 game hours, from day 42.23); with Multiply the fractions multiply. The smallest fraction belongs to starvation from day 1.44, then beriberi from day 67.46 (#4043). The fatal state is beriberi: health is gone at day 77.23, where the line ends, before the BMI reaches 12 (#4022: the Obese body dies of beriberi on day 77.23 and the Gaunt body of starvation on day 40.90, a death the science gives first, not tuned to the hunger strikers' 46-73 days, S2231). Health is under 10 (K.drain.SLEEP_FLOOR, where vanilla wakes a sleeper on every tick, #3900) for the last 14.52 days, from day 62.70. Each state's rate carries its clock's own move in the minute, so a jump in the clock lands in one minute: the largest one-minute fall here is 0.0041, at day 47.00, and the Gaunt body's first record day's close takes 0.82 at once (at 48 h).
